segments.comment: Admission-only variation retained with its matching recording: C normalizes the invalid Healer/elf/chaotic combination to a neutral human Healer, the leading space is consumed as an unknown command, and the final . remains at the blind quick-glance --More-- boundary. It does not establish a selected location. The valid longer variation is retained separately as blind-glance-description-blocked-variation.session.json; its selected-location result is blocked by the missing !quick condition before checkfile in pager.c do_look.
